ActorTalk: That's all I need. Get someone to bring the equipment.
Roger!
Right on time, [PlayerName]. You saw Rosetta before coming here, didn't you?
I'll keep it short. The crisis didn't just hit Babylonia. The Arctic Route Union got caught up in it too.
The Arctic glaciers split apart and started melting. A swarm of Corrupted came out. We still don't know why.
They look like machines that were frozen long ago. Once thawed, they started attacking every settlement in sight.
That includes New Sophiasburgh—the one the Arctic Route Union planned to make their new capital.
Not yet. Resources in the Arctic are too limited.
I've seen the dossier. You were involved in some of the negotiations there.
Back to Rosetta. During the battle to defend New Sophiasburgh, she was ambushed and nearly killed. To save her, they put her into a prototype frame called "Malkuth."
But that frame was still in development—not even the basic tuning was done. Transferring a Construct into an unfinished frame almost guarantees M.I.N.D. instability.
After that, Babylonia got their distress call. I looked into it and found a black box embedded in the frame, and it was interfering with her M.I.N.D.
I'm not sure, but it also works as a startup lock. Until certain conditions are met, the frame won't fully activate. That's why she's still unconscious.
There is... The Arctic's still in danger. Rosetta's their leader, and she can't stay in this state forever.
I need you to dive into her M.I.N.D. and break the black box's lock from the inside. That should wake her up.
Prolonged coma could cause irreversible damage to her M.I.N.D. This is the best option we've got.
And I brought you in for a reason. When it comes to M.I.N.D. diving, you're the best we have.
Go find Mina. He's one of the people who came to Babylonia with Rosetta.
I'll take care of the diving gear and the software, but according to the Arctic mechanoid, the frame ID code is with him.
I tried to track him down, but someone said he wandered off to go sightseeing... We're short on people, so I'll leave this to you.
I'm here, Asimov.
She doesn't look good.
Why is she here?
Is that city even finished yet?
I remember that place.
What's inside it?
...Is there anything we can do?
Won't that hurt her?
What do I need to do?
